description: This file defines the IBatchContainer interface used in Orleans streaming to represent a batch of heterogeneous, ordered events, providing methods to access stream ID, events, sequence token, and request context modification.

classes.name: IBatchContainer
classes.description: An interface representing a batch of events in Orleans streaming, allowing querying of events, stream identification, sequence token, and request context modification.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events of a specific type from the batch, returning an enumerable of tuples containing the event and its associated stream sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Allows the batch to modify the RequestContext before being sent to consumers, returning true if the context was modified.
